map.32 位位运算计算器：AND/OR/XOR/NOT/左移/右移，支持十进制/十六: A 32-bit bitwise calculator: AND/OR/XOR/NOT, left shift and right shift, with decimal, hex and binary input and live visualization of the bit flips.
map.对整数按位执行布尔运算与移位，常用于掩码、标志位与底层协议解析。: Performs bitwise boolean operations and shifts on integers — widely used for masks, flags and low-level protocol parsing.
map.：JS 位运算按 32 位有符号补码处理，超出 32 位会被截断，须注意溢出。: : JavaScript bitwise operations use 32-bit signed two's complement; anything beyond 32 bits is truncated, so watch out for overflow.
map.处理掩码、权限位、底层协议字段。: Work with masks, permission bits and low-level protocol fields.
map.权限位设计：用 READ=1、WRITE=2、EXECUTE=4 组合权限，检查: Permission-bit design: combine permissions as READ=1, WRITE=2, EXECUTE=4 and test a permission with (flags & 4); this is more compact than three boolean columns and fits neatly into a single integer column in the database.
map.& 与 && 区别？: What is the difference between & and &&?
map.& 是按位运算，&& 是逻辑短路运算。: & is a bitwise operation, while && is a short-circuit logical one.
map.右移有符号和无符号的区别？: What is the difference between signed and unsigned right shift?
map.>> 是算术右移，高位补符号位，对负数保持负数（−8 >> 1 = −4）；>>: >> is an arithmetic right shift: it copies the sign bit into the high bits and keeps negative numbers negative (−8 >> 1 = −4). >>> is a logical right shift: the high bits are filled with 0, so a negative number becomes a very large positive one. When working with flags and hashes, use >>> consistently so sign extension does not corrupt the result.
